The table below contains the clinical codes for **Wrist fracture** in CPRD (Read Version 2). This codelist includes fractures of the wrist, distal radius and ulna (such as Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi, and styloid fractures), carpal bones (such as scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, etc.), and fracture-dislocations/subluxations of the wrist joint.

This codelist includes Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Read codes indicating a diagnosis of a **wrist fracture**. Anatomically and clinically, wrist fractures comprise fractures of the lower end (distal) radius and/or ulna (such as Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi fractures, and styloid process fractures), fractures of the carpal bones (such as the scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, etc.), and fracture-dislocations/subluxations at the wrist level.

This codelist includes Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) Read codes indicating a diagnosis of a **wrist fracture**. Anatomically and clinically, wrist fractures comprise fractures of the lower end (distal) radius and/or ulna (such as Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi fractures, and styloid process fractures), fractures of the carpal bones (such as the scaphoid, lunate, triquetrum, etc.), and fracture-dislocations/subluxations at the wrist level.
